concepts.label: Additional Product Classification Details
concepts.description: A product classification for the product other than the Global Product Classification(GPC brick value).

concepts.label: Additive Details
concepts.description: A set of details about one of the additives within the product.

concepts.label: Allergen Details
concepts.description: Details of an allergen for a product.

concepts.label: Authenticity Details
concepts.description: A set of details about covert or overt security features that may contribute to checking the authenticity of a product or product instance.

concepts.label: Award Prize
concepts.description: Describes a prize or award won by a product or organization.

concepts.label: Beverage
concepts.description: Any potable liquid.

concepts.label: Brand
concepts.description: Information on brands and sub-brands for a product.

concepts.label: Certification
concepts.description: Certification issued by a certifying body to a certification subject (Organization, Place, Product).

concepts.label: Clothing
concepts.description: A product that is worn on the body.

concepts.label: Colour Code Details
concepts.description: A set of colour code details (colour code, party controlling the code list) for the product.

concepts.label: Compulsory Additional Information
concepts.description: The group of compulsory information about a product.

concepts.label: Contact
concepts.description: Information on an individual or department acting as point of contact for an organiation.

concepts.label: Country
concepts.description: Country is a complex data type that indicates a country and a country subdivision.

concepts.label: Diet Type Code Details
concepts.description: A set of diet type code details (diet type code and diet type sub code) for the product.

concepts.label: Discount
concepts.description: Provides information on a discount applicable to an offer for example 2 percent.

concepts.label: Food and Beverage Preparation Information
concepts.description: Food and Beverage Preparation Information is a complex data type that indicates a preparation state code and preparation instructions.

concepts.label: Food Beverage Tobacco Ingredient
concepts.description: Food Beverage Tobacco Ingredient is a complex data type that includes an ingredient statement and details.

concepts.label: Food Beverage Tobacco Product
concepts.description: A food, beverage or tobacco product.

concepts.label: Footwear
concepts.description: Outerwear that is worn on the feet such as shoes or boots.

concepts.label: Fruits and Vegetables
concepts.description: Contains properties related specifically to fruit and vegetable products.

concepts.label: GeoCoordinates
concepts.description: The geographic coordinates of a place or event.

concepts.label: GeoShape
concepts.description: The geographic shape of a place. A GeoShape can be described using several properties whose values are based on latitude/longitude pairs. Either whitespace or commas can be used to separate latitude and longitude; whitespace should be used when writing a list of several such points.

concepts.label: Location ID Details
concepts.description: Government bodies, trade organisations, and other parties issue identifiers that are associated to locations. Linking these identifiers to GLN and one another supports consolidating records, mapping related, collaborative identifiers, enhances search ability and enables more efficient transitions...

concepts.label: Location Status History
concepts.description: Over the lifetime of a location, it may go through periods of being active and inactive. gs1:LocationStatusHistory allows changes in status to be communicated in advance and tracked over time.

concepts.label: Meat Poultry
concepts.description: Meat and poultry products.

concepts.label: Message
concepts.description: Any kind of electronic message for communication of information from one party to one or more other parties.

concepts.label: Milk Butter Cream Yogurt Cheese Eggs Substitutes
concepts.description: Milk butter cream yogurts cheese eggs and any substitutes for these products.

concepts.label: Nutrition Measurement Type
concepts.description: A class providing nutritional value and intake percent.

concepts.label: Offer
concepts.description: An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service,for example, an offer to sell tickets to an event, to rent the DVD of a movie, to stream a TV show over the internet, to repair a motorcycle, or to loan a book.

concepts.label: Organic Claim Details
concepts.description: A set of organic claim details for the product.

concepts.label: Organization
concepts.description: An Organization is any legal or physical entity involved at any point in any supply chain and upon which there is a need to retrieve predefined information. An Organization is uniquely identified by a Global Location Number (GLN).

concepts.label: Organisation ID Details
concepts.description: Government bodies, trade organisations, and other parties issue identifiers that are associated to legal entities and/or functions. Linking these identifiers to GLN and one another supports consolidating records, mapping related, collaborative identifiers, enhances search ability and enables more...

concepts.label: Organisation Status History
concepts.description: Over the lifetime of an organisation, it may go through periods of being active and inactive. gs1:OrganizationStatusHistory allows changes in status to be communicated in advance and tracked over time.

concepts.label: Packaging
concepts.description: Details on packaging for a product for example packaging type (bottle), materials, features, recycling, etc..

concepts.label: Packaging Material Details
concepts.description: Information on any material used for packaging.

concepts.label: Place
concepts.description: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical location.

concepts.label: Address
concepts.description: The location at which a particular organization or person may be found or reached.

concepts.label: Price Specification
concepts.description: A structured value representing a monetary amount, consisting of a value and currency code.

concepts.label: Product
concepts.description: Any item (product or service) upon which there is a need to retrieve pre-defined information and that may be priced, or ordered, or invoiced at any point in any supply chain.

concepts.label: Product Yield Details
concepts.description: A grouping of properties related to the yield of a food or beverage product according to a specified type of preparation.

concepts.label: Measurement Type
concepts.description: A point value or interval for product characteristics and other purposes. A unit of measurement is also specified.

concepts.label: Referenced File
concepts.description: Provides URL and other information on a referenced electronic file.

concepts.label: Regulatory Identifier
concepts.description: A repeatable grouping of identifiers that reference one document, record or dataset within one regulatory information system, repository or registry

concepts.label: Regulatory Information
concepts.description: Information on applicable government regulations applicable to a trade item

concepts.label: Regulatory Notification
concepts.description: A notification message about information on applicable government regulations applicable to a trade item

concepts.label: Returnable Package Deposit Details
concepts.description: Details of the deposit for returnable packaging for a product.

concepts.label: Seafood
concepts.description: Seafood Products including fish and shellfish.

concepts.label: Size Code Details
concepts.description: A grouping of properties related to the representing the size of a product, by specifying a value from a specified code list.

concepts.label: Size Details
concepts.description: A grouping of properties related to the size of a wearable product

concepts.label: Target Market Details
concepts.description: A set of target market details (product release date and associated countries) for the product.

concepts.label: Textile Material
concepts.description: Details on the composition of any materials used to make a product using textiles.

concepts.label: Transaction
concepts.description: A repeatable grouping of identifiers that identify a business transaction ID and its type

concepts.label: Type Code
concepts.description: A code list.

concepts.label: Warranty
concepts.description: An assurance that the product is reliable and that repairs or replacement will be done free of charge within a given time limit and under certain conditions in the event of a defect.

concepts.label: Wearable Product
concepts.description: Products that are worn on the body.

concepts.label: Pet Care and Supplies Product
concepts.description: Products specifically designed for domestic animals and pets, including dog and cat toys, chews, pet food, grooming, and accessories.

concepts.label: Toy and Game Product
concepts.description: Items manufactured for play, recreation, and entertainment, including pet chew toys, novelty items, and interactive toys.

concepts.label: Healthcare and Medical Product
concepts.description: Pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostic test kits, vaccines, sterile surgical supplies, and over-the-counter medications.

concepts.label: Electronics and Battery Product
concepts.description: Consumer electronics, computers, smartphones, IoT sensors, electronic components, and lithium-ion battery assemblies requiring UN3480 / UN3481 hazardous transport compliance.

concepts.label: Chemical and Hazardous Material (Hazmat)
concepts.description: Industrial chemicals, flammable liquids, corrosive cleaners, aerosols, paints, solvents, and dangerous goods requiring Safety Data Sheet (SDS) compliance.

concepts.label: Hardware, Tools and Building Supplies
concepts.description: Construction supplies, power tools, hand tools, fasteners, plumbing fixtures, electrical wiring, paint, and lumber.

concepts.label: Cold-Chain Controlled Temperature Logistics
concepts.description: Refrigerated, frozen, deep-freeze, and temperature-controlled cross-dock handling protocols for perishable food and pharmaceuticals.

concepts.label: Reusable Transport Item (RTI / Pallet / Crate)
concepts.description: Returnable logistics assets including wooden Euro pallets, Chep pallets, plastic bulk bins, roll cages, returnable totes, and IBC liquid containers.
